Standalone reproducibility verifies 938 finite numerical/identity checks; infinite claims rely on proof, not simulation.

value.rationale: The exact source diagnostic is intended to correlate probe alignment with PCG progress; the theorem quantifies precisely when a small spectral subspace becomes invisible to that globally normalized diagnostic, shows probe batching cannot correct the deterministic blind region, and pairs it with a rigorous arbitrarily delayed ordinary-CG construction. The exact beta distribution gives calibratable finite-size confidence information, while the diagonal-Jacobi observation connects the construction to the source actual probe generation rather than an unrelated unsmoothed proxy. These are motivated, nontrivial limitations of an emerging numerical method, not merely a known condition-number or two-level exercise.
